OV-2's tile lines are row literals (L275), not §14 keys: 'Live trading: on', 'Kill switch: off', 'Open positions: 2', 'Last backup 04:00 UTC · ok', the '14:00' of tile.withdrawal_ok and the button 'Run tamper check'; all but the button are OV-2's targets (today's main reads OV-6, L279, board 26).

Spec ambiguity: OV-2 (L275) writes 'Maintenance: off', §14's tile.maintenance_off reads 'Maintenance: off (flags read)' (L603; OV-6 L279 draws it so); the board draws the key (§14: 'every screen cites a key, never its own string', L593).

No announce.* key for a new strip item (§14 L600): the announcement is the item's accessible name, 'Attention:' + its env word + its string, after D02:692's form ('Attention: LIVE — key for sub_002 expires in 12 days.'); strip.drift's string already leads with 'Attention:', so its name is the string alone.
One 'as of' for every tile: §1 gives only 14:02:11 (L103); OV-2 (L275) gives each tile its own and no other time.

Spec question: §6 L250 gives [env] to the Trading safety tile alone, while the two key strip items carry [LIVE] (L276) for the serving environment's counts (L264); the Accounts and keys tile is drawn without a badge, as the anatomy says; the spec owner confirms whether it carries [LIVE] too.

Spec question: the strip's key item is key_expiry_n, the form §14 keeps 'until' CG-7 lands (L598; OV-3 L276), while the Accounts tile keeps OV-2's target withdrawal line, which reads the security summary CG-7 gates (L264, L801): with the summary served the item would be strip.key_expiry. The board draws the row as written; the spec owner confirms which world OV-3 shows.

Spec question: the drift item's tone and place. §14 gives strip.drift no tone and L276 lists it last; D02:491 draws the clock drift with the down glyph (octagon, D02:182) and its string says order entry is halted, so under §4 L169 ('the rest by severity then recency') it may lead the strip in the danger tone. The board keeps the row's order and the warning tone (DJ) until the spec owner says.

Record tier, the board's one inline link (CMP-021 in the Accounts tile's capacity line), carries a drawn 1 px color.text.link underline as wide as the estimated text, as on boards 01 and 04 (cvsheet v1 texts take no textDecoration): color.text.link is 2.16:1 against the color.text.primary words beside it (dark #6EA1F5 vs #E8EAED, token-sync), under the 3:1 a colour-only cue needs. The nine tile headings are links by colour and place (each is its tile's heading, CMP-178 on CMP-050, §6 L252-253; hc also underlines them, §15 F3 L655); the strip items and the matching tile lines are pills marked by their fill, the triangle and their '→' words. This line replaces the kit's 'colour + position only' line.

Counts in type.num.base (§6 L287; D02:120 'type.num.base for every count and clock'): a copy string's leading count (the strip items' and the matching lines' '1', cap.unrecorded's '3', Open positions' '2') is its own text node in type.num.base beside the words in type.ui.body, in a row whose space.inset.xs gap stands for the word space; the row's note carries the full string (a link's accessible name). strip.drift's {s} (2.3) is a measured offset, not a count or a clock, so it stays in type.ui.body; the absolute times ('as of 14:02:11', 'checked 14:00 UTC') keep their string's type, as the kit's meta and 'as of' lines do on boards 01-20.

The five items keep the OV-3 row's order (L276). None is a withdrawal, break-glass, tamper or strip.locked item (§4 L168-169); for 'the rest by severity then recency' (L169; D02:118) the spec gives these items no severity and the frame serves no recency, so the row's order and the kit's warning tone stand (DJ; D02:312's 'critical' names the assertive items, not a severity order). The drift item's tone and place are a spec question (copy gaps).

Trading safety's lines are label + value pairs (the kit's pair(): the label color.text.secondary, the value color.text.primary, Open positions' count type.num.base): OV-2's target literals (L275) 'Live trading: on', 'Kill switch: off', 'Open positions: 2', and tile.maintenance_off split at its colon, the row's note carrying the full §14 string.

Grey bars are tile lines OV-3 (L276) does not name and §14 keys no string for: neutral color.surface.hover bars, radius.control, 12 px, no text, one per field group of §6's data table (L261-270), each named 'placeholder · <fields>', 200 / 320 px wide at 1280 / 2560 (never a measure of a value), bar for bar as board 22 (OV-2) draws them. They are not a loading state (OV-1 is board 21).

Matching tile lines (L276 'each matching tile line links to the same control'): §14 has no tile-line key, so each repeats its strip item's §14 string verbatim and is drawn as the kit draws the strip item (a CMP-021 link composition: the triangle on color.status.warning.subtle, color.text.primary, 32 px), wrapped to the tile at 1280, with no env badge (the tile's heading carries none: §6 L250 gives [env] to Trading safety alone). The Accounts tile's tier line is the capacity line, cap.unrecorded (D11; §7 L312), whose Record tier is the same control as strip.tier's (OV-8, board 28).

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

The tiles mirror board 22 (OV-2, gen_22.py; the healthy target frame this one builds on, annotated "today's main reads OV-6", L275; board 26) wherever OV-3 changes nothing: the lines in §6's data-table order (L261-270), the same grey bars, Health's four component bars (one column at 1280, two at 2560; the count is board 22's), the Audit rows, the backup line's check and every tile's 'as of'. OV-3 changes three tiles (L276): Health gains the drift line after its overall bar; Users' without_mfa becomes the two-factor line; Accounts and keys' keys bar becomes the key-expiry and keys-rejected lines and its capacity line turns unrecorded.

The capacity line is stacked, as board 22 stacks cap.recorded in the tile: cap.unrecorded's count and words (wrapping beside the count at 1280), then Record tier on its own line (§7 L311-312 draws one line on SCR-121's 944 px). No CMP-023 meter: none while the tier is unrecorded (§7 L315-316; D10).

The backup line carries the check glyph (icon/check, color.status.success.strong, 9.40 on raised, §15 L642) before 'Last backup 04:00 UTC · ok', as board 22 draws it: CMP-178 renders the state word with one glyph shape per tone (Appendix A L878).

Audit (D9, L122) as board 22 draws it: the tamper line is Run tamper check (the CG-8 fallback, L802; OV-2 L275), a CMP-001 secondary button (Retry's look, 10.17, §15 L641); the three CMP-173 compact rows are 32 px rows holding a grey bar (no entry data in the spec) and the audited-read marker a grey bar (§14 keys no string).

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes). Chrome surface (kit-level, board 06 review r1 finding 5, correcting e42kit's 'no source names a chrome surface'): `15` names color.surface.raised for CMP-071 NavRail and CMP-072 TopBar (15:699, :708) and CMP-209 RightRail (15:2421), color.surface.sunken for CMP-208 StatusBar (15:2411); the boards draw all four on color.surface.app, CMP-070 AppShell's surface (15:690), with color.border.subtle dividers, as boards 01-20 do: D03 takes only E10's sizes (§1 L97), E10-D02 is greyscale with no bespoke colour and leaves the token pass to E10-D03 (E10:20-21), and one chrome on every board keeps them comparable. Binding `15`'s surfaces is a kit change (routed to the kit owner).

32 px pills bind size.control.comfortable as their height (§4 L176: comfortable density, 32 px rows; review r1 finding 4, as gen_07.py, gen_19.py and gen_102.py bind it): the five strip items (kit-level, applied in kit_fixups(); a no-op once e42kit's strip_item() binds it) and every matching tile line drawn on one line (the live checks list which wrap); a wrapped line grows with its words and binds no height. No focus ring is drawn: OV-3 names no focus moment, and a new strip item never moves focus (§4 L200).
